subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce maxRestartsPerHour on pending channel recovery

question: Should `gateway.channelMaxRestartsPerHour` remain a strict cap on every health-monitor `startChannel` invocation, or may one pending continuation exceed the recorded cap to finish an already-started recovery cycle?
rationale: Bounding pending recovery is necessary, but source inspection cannot determine whether an unrecorded completion invocation is an approved interpretation of this existing operator safety setting.

options.title: Budget recovery cycles
options.body: Treat the initial attempt and one bounded pending continuation as a single logical recovery cycle, then document and prove that lifecycle.

options.title: Cap every invocation
options.body: Enforce the configured maximum literally on all `startChannel` calls, accepting that a maximum of one can defer completion until capacity returns.

options.title: Permit explicit plus-one
options.body: Keep the unrecorded completion call and update operator-facing configuration documentation to state the effective pending-recovery limit.

recommendation.title: Budget recovery cycles
recommendation.body: Treat the initial attempt and one bounded pending continuation as a single logical recovery cycle, then document and prove that lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties this person most directly to the introduction of the configurable hourly restart contract.
